FirstPeriodIrregular.1:
Ixesha lam lokuqala lenyanga
alilandelanisi: ngaba oko kuqhelekile?
FirstPeriodIrregular.6: Ewe, oko kuqhelekile kwaphela. Nantsi isizathu sokuba umjikelo ufune ixesha ukuze uzinze, nokuba kufuneka uthethe nogqirha ngoku nini.
FirstPeriodIrregular.11: Ii-hormone ezilawula umjikelo zifuna ixesha ukuze zifumane ukulingana kwazo. Ke ngoko kuqhelekile ukuba imijikelo ibe mifutshane, mide, okanye ingalingani kwiminyaka yokuqala.
FirstPeriodIrregular.12: Umjikelo ungathatha unyaka omnye ukuya kwemibini, ngamanye amaxesha ngaphezulu kancinane, ukuze ulandelane ngakumbi. Eli xesha lokuzilungelelanisa lahluka kakhulu komnye ukuya komnye, ingeyonto yingxaki.
FirstPeriodIrregular.14: Umjikelo ongalandelaniyo ekuqaleni awuzange uthathwe njengokulibaziseka: umzimba wakho uthatha nje ixesha oliyimfuneko.
FirstPeriodIrregular.15: Kuninzi lweemeko, akukho nto ekufanele ukuba ikukhathaze. Noko ke, kulungile ukubona ugqirha ukuba ixesha lakho lenyanga alibonakali iinyanga ezininzi emva kokuba liqale ukubonakala, okanye ukuba unamathandabuzo aqhubekayo.
FirstPeriodIrregular.17: Akukho xesha lenyanga iinyanga ezininzi, intlungu enamandla kakhulu, okanye ukopha kakhulu.
FirstPeriodIrregular.19: Umjikelo olandelanayo okanye ongalandelaniyo: yintoni umahluko?
FirstPeriodIrregular.21: Ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga: ukuba ulindele ntoni
FirstPeriodIrregular.23: Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo ngexesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga
FirstPeriodIrregular.25: Ixesha lam lokuqala lenyanga alilandelanisi: ngaba oko kuqhelekile? — AWA

FirstPeriodProtection.1:
Ndiyikhethe phi indlela yokuzikhusela
exeshini lam lokuqala lenyanga?
FirstPeriodProtection.6: Zininzi iindlela zokuzikhusela exeshini lakho lenyanga. Akukho enye engcono kunenye — ukuba ukhululekile kunguwe okhokelayo ekukhetheni.
FirstPeriodProtection.11: Kwixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga, ipadi ngokuqhelekileyo yeyona ndlela ilula yokuzikhusela, kuba iya ngqo kwingubo yakho yangaphantsi. Ingubo yangaphantsi yexesha lenyanga neetamponi ziindlela ezinye onokuzizama kamva, nanini na xa uziva uthanda.
FirstPeriodProtection.13: Zilula ukuzisebenzisa, ziya kwingubo yakho yangaphantsi kwaye zitshintshwa rhoqo.
FirstPeriodProtection.15: Ingubo yangaphantsi encumayo, ewasheka, ekhululekileyo ekusebenziseni mihla le.
FirstPeriodProtection.17: ZiBekwa ngaphakathi emzimbeni; ukuba uzisebenzisa na kwaye nini kuxhomekeke kuwe, ngesantya sakho.
FirstPeriodProtection.18: Akukho ndlela yokuzikhusela eyiyo okanye engeyiyo: nganye ifanelekile kwimizimba, kwizinto ezenziwa rhoqo, nakwiindlela zokukhululeka ezahlukeneyo. Iitamponi, umzekelo, ziBekwa ngaphakathi emzimbeni kwaye zifuna ukuwuqhelana ngakumbi umzimba wakho — akukho nto ithi kufuneka uzisebenzise ukususela kwixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga.
FirstPeriodProtection.20: Ukuzama iindidi ezahlukeneyo zokuzikhusela ngokuhamba kwexesha kukunceda ufumane eyona ikulungeleyo, ngaphandle koxinzelelo.
FirstPeriodProtection.21: Ngokomndilili, into oyisebenzisayo kufuneka itshintshwe rhoqo emva kweeyure ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-6, rhoqo ngakumbi ngeentsuku zokopha kakhulu. Ukuyitshintsha rhoqo kukunceda uhlale ukhululekile kwaye ugcine inzulu yococeko lwengingqi yangasese.
FirstPeriodProtection.25: Ungawulawula njani umhla ngomhla ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga?
FirstPeriodProtection.27: Ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga: ukuba ulindele ntoni
FirstPeriodProtection.29: Ndiyikhethe phi indlela yokuzikhusela exeshini lam lokuqala lenyanga? — AWA

FirstPeriodSigns.1:
Imiqondiso yokuqala
yexesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga
FirstPeriodSigns.6: Umzimba wakho ufane unike imiqondiso ngaphambi kokuba kufike ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga. Ukuyibona kunganceda uzive ungamangaliswa kangako.
FirstPeriodSigns.11: Kwiinyanga ezandulela ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga, umzimba wakho utshintsha ngobumnene: umzobo wawo uyatshintsha, undwangu lwasemzimbeni luqala ukuvela kwiindawo ezintsha, nokubila kuyatshintsha. Ezi zizinto eziqhelekileyo zokufikisa, ezilungiselela umzimba wakho ngobumnene.
FirstPeriodSigns.13: Olu tshintsho alwenzeki lonke ngaxeshanye, okanye ngesantya esinye, kumntu wonke — oko kuqhelekile kwaphela.
FirstPeriodSigns.15: Umzimba wakho utshintsha ngokucotha kancinane: umzobo wawo, undwangu lwasemzimbeni, nokubila konke kunokutshintsha.
FirstPeriodSigns.17: Amanzi alula, amhlophe kancinane aqhele ukuvela iinyanga ezimbalwa ngaphambi kwexesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga.
FirstPeriodSigns.19: Unokuziva uxinene kancinane okanye uxhuzula esiswini esisezantsi.
FirstPeriodSigns.21: Kuqhelekile ukuziva uphendula ngokukhawuleza okanye uqumba umsindo ngaphezu kokuqhelekileyo.
FirstPeriodSigns.24: Le miqondiso ngokuqhelekileyo ithetha ukuba ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga liza kufika kwiinyanga ezilandelayo, nangona kungenzeki ukuxela umhla ochanekileyo. Ukugcina into yokuzikhusela usondele kuba sisiqhelo esihle ngeli xesha.
FirstPeriodSigns.26: Le miqondiso ziindlela zokukhokela ngokubanzi, ayisosiqikelelo esichanekileyo. Umzimba ngamnye ulandela isantya sawo.
FirstPeriodSigns.28: Ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga: ukuba ulindele ntoni
FirstPeriodSigns.30: Ndazi njani ukuba ixesha lam lokuqala lenyanga liyeza?

FlowColorsTextures.1:
Ukopha kwexesha lenyanga: ukuqonda
iimibala nesimo
FlowColorsTextures.6: Umbala nesimo sokopha kwexesha lakho lenyanga zithetha okuninzi ngempilo yakho yee-hormone. Funda ukuzifunda ukuze uqonde ngcono umjikelo wakho.
FlowColorsTextures.14: Ukopha okutsha, igazi elitsha. Kuqhelekile ekuqaleni kwexesha lakho lenyanga.
FlowColorsTextures.16: Igazi elidala, elinga lisemgangathweni phakathi komjikelo.
FlowColorsTextures.18: Igazi elidala, rhoqo ekupheleni kwexesha lakho lenyanga.
FlowColorsTextures.20: Kunokubonisa ukopha okulula okanye utshintsho lwee-hormone.
FlowColorsTextures.34: Umjikelo oqhelekileyo. Umzimba wakho ususa ubuso bangaphakathi besibeleko.
FlowColorsTextures.36: Igazi elidala, akukho nto ekufanele ikukhathaze.
FlowColorsTextures.38: Kunokwenzeka ekuqaleni/ekupheleni kwexesha lakho lenyanga okanye xa ii-hormone zingalingananga.
FlowColorsTextures.40: Yibukele ukuba iphelekwa livumba elinamandla, ukuhlaba, okanye intlungu.
FlowColorsTextures.42: Ukopha kakhulu kakhulu (utshintsha into yokuzikhusela rhoqo emva kweyure ye-1–2)
FlowColorsTextures.47: Phawula noluphi na utshintsho inyanga nganye.
FlowColorsTextures.54: Ukopha kwexesha lenyanga: ukuqonda iimibala nesimo — AWA

FlowMenstrual.1:
Ukunyamekela ucoceko lwakho lwangasese
exeshini lakho lenyanga
FlowMenstrual.6: Ukunyamekela ucoceko lwakho lwangasese kuthetha ukuwuhlonela umzimba wakho nokulingana kwawo kwemvelo.
FlowMenstrual.13: Exeshini lakho lenyanga, umzimba wakho uyatshintsha kwaye uziva ngakumbi. Ukuqhela izinto ezilungileyo kunceda ukuthintela ukucaphukisa nosulelo, kwaye kukunceda uhlale ukhululekile imihla ngemihla.
FlowMenstrual.14: Hlamba ngobumnene: ukuhlamba nje ngamanzi acacileyo, ukusuka phambili ukuya ngasemva, kwanele ukukhusela izicubu zakho zemvelo.
FlowMenstrual.15: Tshintsha into yokuzikhusela rhoqo: emva kweeyure ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-6 ukuphepha ukumanzi namavumba angathandekiyo.
FlowMenstrual.16: Khetha ikotoni: ingubo yangaphantsi yekotoni iyawuvumela umzimba wakho ukuba uphefumle kwaye inciphisa ingozi yokucaphukisa.
FlowMenstrual.18: Ukuhlamba ngaphakathi esiniinzi, okuphazamisa izicubu zakho zemvelo
FlowMenstrual.19: Ukugcina ipadi okanye itamponi emanzi ixesha elide kakhulu
FlowMenstrual.21: Ivumba okanye ukuphuma kwamanzi okungaqhelekanga okwahlukileyo koko kuqhelekileyo kuwe
FlowMenstrual.24: Umzimba wakho sele unendlela yawo yemvelo yokulingana. Ukuhlamba ngobumnene ngokuqhelekileyo kwanele.
FlowMenstrual.33: Ukukhetha into efanelekileyo yokuzikhusela emzimbeni wakho
FlowMenstrual.35: Ungazipholisa njani iintlungu zokuya exesheni ngendlela yemvelo
FlowMenstrual.38: Ukunyamekela ucoceko lwakho lwangasese exeshini lakho lenyanga · AWA

HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.1: Ukubukwa ngokubanzi kokunyangwa kokuthintela inkulelo nge-hormone
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.6: Ipilisi, ipatshi, indandatho, i-implant, i-IUD ye-hormone: yintoni ezahlula zona nendlela yokucinga ngendlela elungele ubomi bakho bemihla ngemihla.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.12: Iindlela ze-hormone zisebenzisa ii-hormone ukuthintela ukukhulelwa. Kuxhomekeke kwindlela, zinokuthintela ngakumbi i-ovulation, zishinyishe ubumanzi bomlomo wesibeleko, kwaye zitshintshe indawo yesibeleko.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.16: Ezinye iindlela zithintela okanye zinqanda ukukhutshwa kweqanda.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.18: Ubumanzi bunokuba shinyeneyo, nto leyo yenza kube nzima ukuba isidoda sidlule.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.20: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezi ndlela kunceda ukunciphisa ingozi yokukhulelwa.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.21: Zonke iindlela azifuni inqanaba elifanayo lokuzibandakanya. Umahluko ophambili kukuba kufuneka ucinge kangaphi ngokuthintela kwakho inkulelo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.23: Ukusuka kwisenzo semihla ngemihla ukuya kwintsebenzo yexesha elide
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.30: Ilungile ukuba ufuna ukuzilawula wena ukuthintela kwakho inkulelo
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.34: Ilungele ukuba ufuna ukuphepha isiqhelo semihla ngemihla
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.38: Indlela efihlakeleyo ekufuneka inqumle izenzo ezimbalwa mihla le
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.42: Ifanelekile ukuba ufuna ukuthintela inkulelo exesha elide
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.46: Isisombululo sexesha elide esifuna ukugcinwa okuncinane kakhulu
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.48: Xa indlela ifuna izenzo ezimbalwa mihla le, kuncipha ukuba ucinge ngayo rhoqo. Oku kunokufanelekela ukuqwalaselwa ukuba uyazi ukuba unokulibala ithamsanqa okanye utshintsho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.49: Akukho ndlela enye efanelekileyo kumntu wonke. Ukhetho olugqwesileyo luxhomekeke kubomi bakho bemihla ngemihla, kwizinto ozithandayo, ekunyamezeleni kwakho, nakwizicwangciso zakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.51: Ezinye iindlela zifuna isenzo semihla ngemihla, ngeli xesha ezinye zisebenza iiveki ezininzi okanye iminyaka.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.53: Indlela esiziva ngayo indlela inokwahluka komnye ukuya komnye. Ukuthetha nengcali yezempilo kunganceda ukufumana okukulungeleyo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.55: Ukuba unethemba lokukhulelwa kungekudala okanye kamva, ixesha lendlela nokubuyiselwa kwayo kunganceda ukukhokela ukhetho lwakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.57: Ukuzifihla, ukulula, ukungabikho kwesiqhelo semihla ngemihla, okanye ukukhuselwa ixesha elide: okuphambili kuwe kubalulekile kwesi sigqibo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.59: “Ndingathanda ukucinga ngokuthintela kwam inkulelo mihla le, rhoqo evekini, okanye kuphela amaxesha ambalwa ngonyaka?”
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.61: Ipilisi okanye indlela efuna ukuqwalaselwa rhoqo
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.65: I-implant okanye i-IUD ye-hormone yexesha elide
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.67: Ukukhetha indlela yokuthintela inkulelo nge-hormone kufuneka kuthathele ingqalelo imeko yakho yobuqu neyempilo. Ingcali yezempilo inokukunceda uthelekise izibonelelo, iingozi, izizathu zokungasebenzisi, neziphumo ezinokubakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.70: Iindlela ze-hormone zisebenzisa ukuhlanganiswa kwee-hormone okwahlukileyo neenkqubo zokusetyenziswa ezahlukeneyo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.71: Ipilisi, ipatshi, nendandatho zifuna ukuzibandakanya okuqhubekayo, ngeli xesha i-implant ne-IUD ye-hormone ziindlela zexesha elide.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.72: Ukhetho kufuneka lulungele ubomi bakho bemihla ngemihla, izinto ozithandayo, ukunyamezela kwakho, nezicwangciso zakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.73: Akukho ndlela “egqwesileyo” kubo bonke — kufuneka ngakumbi ihambelane neentswelo zakho nemeko yakho.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.75: Ukuthatha ixesha lokuthelekisa iindlela nengcali yezempilo kukunceda ukhethe indlela yokuthintela inkulelo onokuyisebenzisa ngokuthula nangokuzinzileyo.

HotFlashes.6: Isizathu sokuba kwenzeke, indlela yokuchonga izinto ezikubangelayo, nezisombululo ezinokunceda xa kuqala ukukhathaza.
HotFlashes.14: Ukutsha kwemizimba kuqhelekile kakhulu ngexesha lokuguquka kwi-menopause. Kunxulumene ngokuyinxalenye notshintsho lwee-hormone oluchaphazela indlela ingqondo ilawula ngayo ubushushu bomzimba.
HotFlashes.15: Utshintsho olunganeno kubushushu bomzimba lunokuziva njengobushushu obuphuma ngequbuliso. Umzimba uphendula ngokuvula imithambo yegazi esikhunjeni, nto leyo enokubangela ukuziva ushushu, ukubomvu, nangamanye amaxesha ukubila kakhulu.
HotFlashes.17: Abanye abafazi bahlangabezana nezihlandlo ezimbalwa evekini, ngeli xesha abanye bangaba nezininzi ngemini. Amandla nobude bunokwahluka.
HotFlashes.18: Xa kwenzeka ngexesha lokulala, ukutsha kwemizimba kunokubangela ukubila ebusuku. Kunokukwenza uvuke rhoqo kwaye kwenze ukulala kungapholisi kakhulu.
HotFlashes.19: Ukungalali ngokwaneleyo kunokongeza ukudinwa, ubunzima bokugxila, nokucaphuka emini. Ke ngoko kunganceda ukuthathela ingqalelo umgangatho wokulala xa uvavanya impembelelo yeempawu zakho.
HotFlashes.21: Iipijama ezivumela umoya, izingubo zokulala ezilula, nekamero ephole ngokwaneleyo zinganceda ukunciphisa ukungakhululeki ebusuku.
HotFlashes.22: Ezinye izinto zinokubangela okanye zonyuse ukutsha komzimba. Azibangeli zimpawu kumntu wonke, kodwa ukuzichonga kunganceda uqonde ngcono iindlela zakho.
HotFlashes.26: Igumbi eliqhumayo okanye impahla enzima kakhulu
HotFlashes.28: Kwiiveki ezimbalwa, phawula xa kwenzeka ukutsha kwemizimba, bunamandla kangakanani, nokwenzekileyo kwangaphambi kwaso. Oku kunganceda ukubona izinto ezikubangelayo wena.
HotFlashes.29: Xhoma izingubo ezilula ngokubeka phezu kwenye
HotFlashes.30: Gcina indawo yakho ipholile kwaye ifumana umoya ococekileyo
HotFlashes.33: Ezi ndlela azizokuthi zenze ukutsha kwemizimba kunyamalale, kodwa zinokwenza amaxesha alula ukuwalawula nokunciphisa ukungakhululeki xa kwenzeka.
HotFlashes.34: Ukutsha kwemizimba kuqhelekile ngexesha le-perimenopause ne-menopause. Noko ke, akufuneki ujongane nako nje ukuba kunzima ukuhlala nako. Ugqirha okanye umbelekisi unokuvavanya iimpawu zakho kwaye axoxe nawe ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
HotFlashes.36: Ukubonana nengcali kunokunceda ngokukodwa xa iimpawu zinempembelelo enkulu ebomini bakho bemihla ngemihla okanye xa ufuna ukwazi ukuba zeziphi iindlela ezikhoyo.
HotFlashes.38: Ukutsha kwemizimba okuqhelekileyo okanye ukubila ebusuku okubangela ukuvuka rhoqo, ukudinwa okukhulu, okanye ubunzima bokusebenza ngokuqhelekileyo emini.
HotFlashes.40: Ukuba ukutsha kwemizimba kuphazamisa umsebenzi wakho, imisebenzi, uhambo, ubudlelwane bentlalo, okanye nje ukukhululeka kwakho kwemihla ngemihla.
HotFlashes.42: Ukwanda okucacileyo kokuphindaphinda okanye kwamandla eempawu kufanele kuxoxwe ukuze kufunyanwe izisombululo ezifanelekileyo kakhulu.
HotFlashes.44: Iindlela ze-hormone nezingezizo ze-hormone zinokucetyiswa ngokuxhomekeke kwimeko yakho. Ingcali inokukunceda uthelekise izibonelelo zazo, iingozi, nezizathu zokungasebenzisi ezinokubakho.
HotFlashes.46: Ukutsha komzimba kunokuba nezizathu ezahlukeneyo. Ezinye iimpawu zinokunxulumana nomgqomo, enye imeko yezempilo, okanye utshintsho olukhulu empilweni yakho. Ukuba enye into iziva ingaqhelekanga, intsha, okanye inamandla ngokukodwa, kungcono ukuthetha nengcali kunokuthatha ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba yi-menopause.
HotFlashes.48: Intlungu esifubeni, ukuphelelwa ngumoya ngequbuliso, ukuziva ukuzolo ukukhubeka, ubuthathaka obuphuma ngequbuliso, okanye ukudumba okungaqhelekanga okuneentlungu emlenzeni omnye kufuna ukhathalelo lwezonyango ngokukhawuleza.
HotFlashes.49: Ziziphi iimpawu ekufuneka uzibeke ingqalelo ekhethekileyo?
HotFlashes.51: Ukuphelelwa ngumoya ngequbuliso okanye ubunzima obukhulu bokuphefumla
HotFlashes.52: Ukuziva ukuzolo ukukhubeka okanye ukulahleka kokuqonda
HotFlashes.53: Ubuthathaka obuphuma ngequbuliso, okanye ubunzima bokuthetha okanye bokubona
HotFlashes.56: Ukuba ukutsha kwemizimba kukhathaza ngokwaneleyo ukuba kufune ukulawulwa, kunokuthathelwa ingqalelo iindlela ezininzi. Ngokuxhomekeke kwimeko yakho, ingcali inokuxoxa ngeendlela zokuphila, unyango olungezizo ze-hormone, okanye, xa kufanelekile, unyango lwe-hormone.
HotFlashes.58: Ubudala, iimpawu, imbali yezempilo, unyango lwangoku, nezinto ozithandayo konke kunokuchaphazela iindlela ezinikezelwayo.
HotFlashes.60: Ukufika unolwazi oluthile kunokwenza ukubonana nengcali kube luncedo ngakumbi. Ungalandela, iintsuku okanye iiveki ezimbalwa, ukuba amaxesha enzeka kangaphi, abakho namandla kangakanani, nempembelelo yawo ekulaleni kwakho okanye kwimisebenzi yakho.
HotFlashes.64: Ngaba kuqhele ukwenzeka emini, ebusuku, okanye zombini?
HotFlashes.65: Ngaba kuphazamisa ukulala kwakho okanye imisebenzi yakho?
HotFlashes.67: Ngaba okwangoku uthatha nawuphi na umgqomo okanye ukuthintela inkulelo nge-hormone?
HotFlashes.68: Akufuneki ulinde de iimpawu zibe nzima kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba uthethe ngazo. Ukubonana nengcali kunganceda nje ukuqonda okwenzekayo nokufunda ngezisombululo ezikhoyo.
HotFlashes.70: Ukutsha kwemizimba kuqhelekile ngexesha lokuguquka kwi-menopause.
HotFlashes.71: Ukuchonga izinto ezikubangelayo kunganceda ukulawula amaxesha ngcono.
HotFlashes.72: Izinto ezilula zemihla ngemihla zinganciphisa ukungakhululeki kwemihla ngemihla.
HotFlashes.73: Ukuba iimpawu ziphazamisa ukulala kwakho okanye ubomi bemihla ngemihla, thetha nengcali.
HotFlashes.74: Iindlela ezininzi zokulawula zinokuxoxwa ngokuxhomekeke kwimeko yakho.
HotFlashes.75: Ukutsha kwemizimba kuqhelekile, kodwa akufuneki kudelelwe xa kuchaphazela ukulala kwakho, umsebenzi, okanye impilo yakho. Ukuphaphela iimpawu zakho nokuthetha nengcali kunganceda ukuqonda ngcono isizathu sazo nokuphonononga izisombululo ezifanelekileyo.
HotFlashes.76: Eli nqaku lolwazi kuphela kwaye alithathi indawo yengcebiso yezonyango eyenzelwe wena.

HydrationCycle.1:
Ukuhlala unamanzi ngokwaneleyo
ngexesha lomjikelo wakho
HydrationCycle.6: Kuyamangalisa kodwa kunjalo: ukuhlala unamanzi ngokwaneleyo kunceda umzimba wakho ukuba ugcine amanzi ambalwa kuyo yonke imijikelo yakho.
HydrationCycle.9: Iintswelo kuzo zonke izigaba zomjikelo wakho
HydrationCycle.15: Kuyamangalisa kodwa kunjalo: ukuhlala unamanzi ngokwaneleyo kunceda umzimba ukuba ugcine amanzi ambalwa kwaye unciphisa ukudumba, ngakumbi ekupheleni komjikelo.
HydrationCycle.17: Xa umzimba ungenamanzi aneleyo, uthanda ukugcina amaninzi njengesilumkiso. Ukusela ngokwaneleyo kuwuxelela, kwelinye icala, ukuba ungawakhupha amanzi ngokulula.
HydrationCycle.18: Iintswelo zakho zamanzi zihlala zizinzile ngokubanzi, kunye neentlobo ezithile ngokweqonga:
HydrationCycle.20: Amanzi athe ngqo angaphezulu kancinane anceda ukuhlawulela ulwelo olulahlekileyo kwaye anciphise ukudumba.
HydrationCycle.22: Iintswelo zihlala zizinzile; ukonyuka okuncinane kobushushu bomzimba kunokwandisa unxano lwamanzi.

Istihada.6: Ukwahlula ukopha okungalandelaniyo kwixesha lakho lenyanga eliqhelekileyo, kunye neempawu zokukhokela ngokubanzi.
Istihada.8: Lo mxholo wemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufuneka iqinisekiswe ziingcali ezifanelekileyo. I-AWA ayikhuphi ii-fatwa okanye izigqibo zenkolo ezenzelwe umntu ngamnye.
Istihada.17: I-Istihada ibhekisa ekopheni okwenzeka ngaphandle komjikelo wenyanga oqhelekileyo, okanye okuqhubeka ngaphaya kobude bexesha lenyanga eliqatshelwa lisiko lamaSilamsi. Ngokungafaniyo nexesha lenyanga (hayd) okanye i-nifas (ukopha emva kokuzala), ayinalo isimo esifanayo senkolo: ngokubanzi ithathwa njengokopha kohlobo olwahlukileyo, ngamanye amaxesha kunxulunyaniswa nesizathu sezonyango.
Istihada.19: Lo mxholo ucacisa ingqiqo ngokubanzi; awukuvumeli ukumisela ukuba ukopha okuthile kuhambelana na ne-Istihada kwimeko yakho yobuqu.
Istihada.20: Kunokuba nzima ukwahlula i-Istihada kwixesha lenyanga okanye emjikelweni ongalandelaniyo, kuba ukopha kunokubonakala kufana ngamanye amaxesha, kwahluke ngamandla, okanye kuqhubeke ngendlela engaqhelekanga. Obu bunzima buqatshelwa ziingcali ngokwazo, nto leyo icacisa isizathu sokuba kubekho iindlela ezininzi zokuyichonga.
Istihada.22: Kuqhelekile ukungazi ngoko nangoko ukuba ukopha okungaqhelekanga kuhambelana nantoni; olu ngathandabuzo luyimeko eqhelekileyo, ayisosiphoso sakho.
Istihada.23: Ezinye izinto zinokunceda ukukhokela ukucinga kwakho, ngaphandle kokuba ngumthetho wehlabathi jikelele, kuba iimpawu ezichanekileyo ziyahluka ngokweemfundiso zomthetho wamaSilamsi.
Istihada.25: Ubude xa kuthelekiswa nomjikelo wakho oqhelekileyo
Istihada.29: Indlela ukopha okuguquka ngayo ngokuhamba kwexesha
Istihada.33: Ezi zinto ziimpawu ezibanzi, ayizizo izikhokelo eziqinileyo: zinokutolikwa ngokwahlukileyo ziingcali neemfundiso zomthetho wamaSilamsi.
Istihada.34: Ukuthatha ixesha lokubukela ukopha kwakho iintsuku ezininzi, ungakhawuleziswa, kukunceda uqonde ngcono imeko yakho ngaphambi kokufikelela esigqibeni.
Istihada.36: Phawula umhla wokuqala kwaye, ukuba unako, ubude obuqhelekileyo bemijikelo yakho
Istihada.37: Bukela ukuba ukopha kulandela indlela esondeleyo kumaxesha akho adlulileyo enyanga
Istihada.39: Rekhoda oku kubukela ukuba ucwangcisa ukubonana nengcali yenkolo okanye nengcali yezempilo
Istihada.40: Kwimeko ye-Istihada, umthandazo (salat) nokuzila (sawm) ngokubanzi kuhlala kuyimfuneko, ngokungafaniyo ngexesha lenyanga. Ke ngoko kucetyiswa izilumkiso zococeko (ezifana nokusebenzisa into efanelekileyo yokuzikhusela) ukuvumela unqulo ukuba luqhubeke, ngokweendlela ezifundiswa ziimfundiso ezahlukeneyo zomthetho wamaSilamsi.
Istihada.42: Izilumkiso ezichanekileyo (ezifana nokuhlaziya i-wudu) zinokwahluka ngokuxhomekeke kwimfundiso yomthetho elandelwayo; ukubhekisa kwimbono oyilandelayo rhoqo okanye kwingcali efanelekileyo kukunceda uzisebenzise ngokuchanekileyo.
Istihada.43: Ukuthandabuza okuqhubekayo ngohlobo lokopha yimeko eqhelekileyo, kwaye akufuneki kube yimvelaphi yokukhathazeka okpreterileyo.
Istihada.44: Bhekisa kubude nokulandelana okuqhelekileyo kwamaxesha akho enyanga
Istihada.45: Bonana nengcali yezempilo ukuba ukopha akuqhelekanga okanye kuyaqhubeka ixesha elide
Istihada.46: Cela ingcali efanelekileyo imbono yayo ngobungakanani benkolo
Istihada.47: Khumbula ukuba impendulo ebanzi ayithathi ndawo yesikhokelo esifanelekileyo kwimeko yakho
Istihada.49: Lo mxholo uhlala uyimfundo kwaye uyabanzi: awuyiyo i-fatwa okanye isigqibo senkolo somntu ngamnye. Kuyo nayiphi na imeko yobuqu, ngakumbi xa kukho ukuthandabuza okuqhubekayo, imbono yengcali efanelekileyo ihlala iyisalathiso.
Istihada.51: I-Istihada yingqiqo eyahlula ukopha okungaqhelekanga kwixesha lenyanga okanye i-nifas, enemiphumo ethile kumthandazo (salat) nokuzila (sawm). Xa unamathandabuzo, ukubukela ngocoselelo nembono yengcali efanelekileyo zihlala zizizinto ezingcono.
